# Planned Maintenance Outage at S-SFX-005

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `S-SFX-005`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence from completed maintenance window MW-0005 matching the exact timing of the SITE_DOWN alarm and KPI drops on S-SFX-005, with sibling sites and transport links verified as unaffected. External events were NOT CHECKED via tool call.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-14 02:45 to 2026-09-14 06:18
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-14 02:38
- **Affected:** S-SFX-005

## Summary

Planned battery replacement and cabinet inspection taking the site offline for the duration of the works.

Traffic and availability at site S-SFX-005 dropped to zero during the maintenance window and recovered fully after completion.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-14 02:38: Planned maintenance MW-0005 started on S-SFX-005 for battery replacement and cabinet inspection. [MW-0005]
- 2026-09-14 02:45: Traffic and availability dropped to zero at S-SFX-005. [ALR-0022]
- 2026-09-14 02:46: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm ALM-000284 raised on S-SFX-005. [ALM-000284]
- 2026-09-14 06:18: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm ALM-000284 cleared on S-SFX-005. [ALM-000284]
- 2026-09-14 06:28: Planned maintenance MW-0005 completed on S-SFX-005. [MW-0005]

## Evidence

- Site S-SFX-005 experienced an active detector alert and complete drop in availability and traffic between 2026-09-14 02:45 and 2026-09-14 06:18. [T1, ALR-0022, ANM-000175, ANM-000176, ANM-000177]
- A critical SITE_DOWN alarm was active on S-SFX-005 from 2026-09-14 02:46 until 2026-09-14 06:18. [T3, ALM-000284]
- Planned maintenance MW-0005 for battery replacement and cabinet inspection took place on S-SFX-005 from 2026-09-14 02:38 to 2026-09-14 06:28 with expected site offline impact. [T5, MW-0005]
- Sibling sites S-SFX-007 and S-SFX-008 and parent transport link LNK-SFX-01-A showed no degradation or KPI deviation during the incident window. [T6, T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at S-SFX-005: confirmed. The planned maintenance window MW-0005 perfectly aligns in time with the site outage and accounts for the SITE_DOWN alarm and zero traffic. [MW-0005, ALM-000284]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SFX-01-A: rejected. Sibling sites sharing the same microwave link remained fully available with no KPI deviations. [T6, T7]

## Ruled out

- T4: No unplanned configuration changes were executed during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Ensure future maintenance windows are properly tagged in dashboards to correlate automated alarms with planned works seamlessly.
